{{short description|German mathematician}}

[[File:William Threlfall.jpg|thumb|William Threlfall in 1936]]
'''William Richard Maximilian Hugo Threlfall''' (25 June 1888, in [[Dresden]] – 4 April 1949, in [[Oberwolfach]]) was a British-born [[Germany|German]] [[mathematician]] who worked on [[algebraic topology]]. He was a coauthor of the standard textbook [[Lehrbuch der Topologie]].

In 1933 he signed the ''[[Vow of allegiance of the Professors of the German Universities and High-Schools to Adolf Hitler and the National Socialistic State]]''.
